definition: to cause something to be taken to another place
description: A young woman with a black bob sits at a wooden desk by a bright window, a green cardigan on, tapping a black fountain pen against her lips while she thinks over a sheet of writing paper. She then writes a handwritten letter across the page, folds the finished sheet, slides it into a cream envelope and presses the flap down flat with both hands. In the last shot she stands in the street at a red pillar postbox, smiling as she pushes the envelope through the slot.

taps.phrase: to write a letter by hand
